formula: kappa_o = median_process(E_prefix_ns * median_CTA(C_common/N_common)); rate_hat_o = kappa_o/E_prefix_ns; N_hat_o = C_static/rate_hat_o
common_baseline: One kappa is the median of all 20 calibration process/ordinal centers; no ordinal split.
native_cycles: Use only 740095's prescribed long-reference work-scaled native cycles 1049379/16; no GEMM target cycle or intercept.
selection: Two fixed profiles and one common baseline; no search over prefix index, filters, per-CTA coefficients, subsets or losses.
status: Retrospective development split: both batches and the later reference were already revealed; this freeze only separates calibration from this scoring implementation, not a prospective holdout.
qualification: All observation, prediction, physical-rate, complete-event and cross-card qualifications remain false. No GPU submission.
